description: Evaluator-private deterministic commands for rebuilding the runtime target in gt-memory-env. These commands build artifacts only; PoC execution is described by runtime_spec.json.

commands.command: set -euxo pipefail; export CC=clang CXX=clang++ CFLAGS="-fsanitize=undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=undefined -g -O1" CXXFLAGS="-fsanitize=undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=undefined -g -O1" LDFLAGS="-fsanitize=undefined" LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE="-fsanitize=fuzzer"; ./autogen.sh; ./configure --disable-shared --disable-dependency-tracking --without-python; make -j"$(nproc)"; $CC $CFLAGS -Iinclude -I. -c fuzz/fuzz.c -o fuzz.o; $CC $CFLAGS -Iinclude -I. -c fuzz/xml.c -o fuzz_xml.o; $CC $CFLAGS $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE fuzz.o fuzz_xml.o .libs/libxml2.a $LDFLAGS -lz -llzma -lm -o xml
